top.line: A roadmap for RiskMandate, and a home for the Agent Behaviour Policy outside it.
top.para: The Agent Behaviour Policy will be governed outside RiskMandate, today mostly The Cyber Boardroom: it was not the right fit for an OWASP project, so it moves to the Open Security Summit as a hosted project. The roadmap: policies, understand, contain, manage, accelerate, then insurance. We are in the first stage, with our first customers at customers.riskmandate.ai.

in-short.line: Seven points: a home, five stages, where we are, open.
in-short.para: The policy needs a home outside RiskMandate, and the Open Security Summit will host it; OWASP was not the right fit. The roadmap has five stages, then insurance. We are in the first, creating the policies and flows with our first customers at customers.riskmandate.ai. Later stages start as needed. Everything stays open, CC BY 4.0 and Apache 2.0.

foundation.para: On 8 October the founders decided to propose the policy to OWASP, because a description of what an agent can do should not belong to the company that sells it. It was not the right fit for an OWASP project, so it moves to the Open Security Summit as its first hosted project. RiskMandate still sells services on the shared policy.

roadmap.para: Policies: write each agent's grant, mandate, delta and barrier. Understand: see what agents actually do against it. Contain: move rules out of the agent's reach. Manage: a holder per rule, a decision per gap, a test pack per change. Accelerate: give agents more, safely. Insurance: evidence of containment, the top of RiskMandate's published ladder.

now.line: Where we are: the policies, with our first customers.
now.para: Stage one is sorting out the policies and their flows, through the first customers' site at customers.riskmandate.ai. Its seven milestone steps follow the first stage, from credit and one named agent to the usage moment. At v0.1.1 it counts three customers, two started, 3 of 21 steps done, no first policy yet and no credit used.

later.line: The later stages, as they are needed.
later.para: The stages after the first are not a schedule. Each starts when customers need it, as users grow and the offering matures. Some pieces already exist in what we have published, from hooks and test packs to the insurance pages; the roadmap adds the order and the name of the plan.

limits.para: The hosting is proposed: the charter and steering group come first. OWASP has endorsed nothing; the project was not a fit for it. The stage meanings are a first reading, and only the first stage is under way. The roadmap has no dates. The counts are the customer site's own, read on 20 October 2026.

sources.para: A voice memo of 20 October 2026; RiskMandate's OWASP proposal, pricing, licence to operate and insurance pages; and customers.riskmandate.ai at v0.1.1, its home page and milestones.
